zh.home.hero.sub: 棋藝、即時競技與益智方塊：自己練習、和家人同機玩，或邀請朋友線上對戰。第一次玩也有教學帶你開始。
zh.home.features.online.desc: 建立房間邀請朋友，或透過配對尋找對手。
zh.game.chess.desc: 守住自己的國王，設法將死對手。從基本走法開始，逐步學會西洋棋的攻守。
zh.game.xiangqi.desc: 隔著楚河漢界鬥智，運用車、馬、炮進攻。採本站公開的象棋規則，含簡化長將、長捉裁決。
zh.game.banqi.desc: 翻開棋子，觀察局勢，再決定移動或吃子。預設採台灣常見版，開局前可查看完整局規。
zh.game.territory.desc: 離開領地畫出軌跡，再繞回來擴大地盤。留意對手，別讓自己的軌跡被切斷！
zh.game.snake.desc: 吃食物、變長，留出轉彎的空間。自己挑戰紀錄，或加入最多 8 人的競技場。
zh.game.blocks.desc: 移動與旋轉落下的方塊，填滿整行就能消除。練習堆疊，或用消行向對手送出障礙行。
zh.online.reconnecting: 連線中斷，正在重新連線。對局可能仍在進行。
zh.online.waiting: 等待對手加入。你可以分享房間連結邀請朋友。
zh.online.notFound: 找不到房間，可能已結束或過期。請確認邀請連結。
zh.err.generic: 這次操作未完成，請稍後再試。
zh.err.network: 網路連線失敗，請檢查連線後重試。
zh.err.rateLimit: 操作太快了，請稍候再試。
zh.err.illegal: 這一步不符合規則，請選擇其他位置。
zh.err.notYourTurn: 還沒輪到你，請等待對手完成這一步。
zh.err.loadFailed: 無法讀取這份對局檔案，請確認檔案格式。
zh.err.engine: 電腦對手載入失敗，已切換為備用對手。
zh.err.notFound: 找不到這個頁面，請從首頁選擇遊戲。

en.home.hero.sub: Explore board games, real-time arenas and block puzzles. Practise solo, share a device with family, or invite friends online. New here? Start with a tutorial.
en.home.features.online.desc: Create a room for friends or find an opponent through matchmaking.
en.game.chess.desc: Protect your king and checkmate your opponent. Learn the basic moves, then build your attacking and defensive skills.
en.game.xiangqi.desc: Plan your attack with chariots, horses and cannons. Uses our published rules, including simplified perpetual-check and chase decisions.
en.game.banqi.desc: Flip a piece, read the board, then choose whether to move or capture. Taiwan rules are the default; check the full rules before playing.
en.game.territory.desc: Leave your land, draw a trail and return to claim more territory. Watch your rivals: an exposed trail can be cut!
en.game.snake.desc: Eat, grow and leave room to turn. Chase your own best score or enter an arena with up to 8 players.
en.game.blocks.desc: Move and rotate falling blocks to fill and clear rows. Practise stacking or clear rows to send obstacles to your opponent.
en.online.reconnecting: Connection lost. Reconnecting… The match may still be running.
en.online.waiting: Waiting for an opponent. Share the room link to invite a friend.
en.online.notFound: Room not found. It may have ended or expired. Check your invite link.
en.err.generic: That action could not be completed. Please try again shortly.
en.err.network: Connection failed. Check your network and try again.
en.err.rateLimit: Too many actions at once. Please wait a moment and try again.
en.err.illegal: That move is not allowed. Choose another square.
en.err.notYourTurn: It is not your turn yet. Wait for your opponent to move.
en.err.loadFailed: This game file could not be read. Check the file format.
en.err.engine: The computer opponent could not load. A backup opponent is now in use.
en.err.notFound: Page not found. Choose a game from the home page.

zh.onboarding.chess: 目標是將死對方國王。先選自己的棋子，再選可走的位置；不確定時，可以先進入教學。
zh.onboarding.xiangqi: 紅方先走。點選棋子查看可走的位置，進攻時也別忘了保護將帥。無合法著法的一方會輸。
zh.onboarding.banqi: 先手第一步翻開的顏色，就是先手的陣營。每回合選擇翻棋、移動或吃子；炮吃子要隔一枚棋子。
zh.onboarding.territory: 離開自己的領地畫出軌跡，再安全繞回來就能圈地。先試一個小圈，留意自己的軌跡。
zh.onboarding.snake: 轉向吃到食物，讓蛇慢慢變長。別急著搶食，先留出安全的路；碰撞規則依目前模式顯示。
zh.onboarding.blocks: 先看落點，再移動或旋轉方塊。填滿整行就會消除；硬降會立即把方塊放到底部，按下前先確認。
zh.online.reconnectFailed: 暫時無法恢復連線。請再次嘗試，或離開房間；對局依原規則繼續。
zh.rules.xiangqi.version: JY Games 台灣象棋規則 v1.0
zh.rules.xiangqi.summary: 同一局面與輪走方第三次出現時，先判長將，再判簡化長捉，其餘依規則判和。完整條件與判例請見規則說明。
zh.rules.banqi.summary: 台灣常見版：炮可移動一格，隔一子吃棋；兵可吃帥、帥不可吃兵；連吃關閉。連續 50 步無吃子也無翻棋則和局，單方一次動作算一步。
zh.tutorial.actionDone: 做到了！觀察盤面如何改變，再繼續下一步。
zh.tutorial.tryAgain: 還沒完成這一步，看看提示再試一次。
zh.tutorial.finish: 練習完成！可以再試一次，或開始一局。

en.onboarding.chess: Your goal is to checkmate the other king. Select one of your pieces, then a legal destination. If you are unsure, start with the tutorial.
en.onboarding.xiangqi: Red moves first. Select a piece to see its legal moves, and protect your general as you attack. A player with no legal moves loses.
en.onboarding.banqi: The first piece flipped determines the first player's colour. Each turn, flip, move or capture. A cannon needs exactly one piece between it and its target.
en.onboarding.territory: Leave your territory to draw a trail, then return safely to claim the enclosed area. Start with a small loop and watch your trail.
en.onboarding.snake: Turn towards food and grow your snake. Leave yourself a safe route before chasing food. Collision rules depend on the selected mode.
en.onboarding.blocks: Check the landing spot, then move or rotate the block. Full rows disappear. Hard drop places the block at the bottom immediately, so check before pressing it.
en.online.reconnectFailed: Unable to reconnect for now. Try again or leave the room. The match continues under its original rules.
en.rules.xiangqi.version: JY Games Taiwan Xiangqi Rules v1.0
en.rules.xiangqi.summary: When the same position and side to move appear for the third time, perpetual check is considered before simplified chase rules. Other repetitions are draws as specified in the rules. See the full rules and examples.
en.rules.banqi.summary: Taiwan rules: cannons move one square and capture over exactly one piece; soldiers can capture generals, but not vice versa. Chain captures are off. After 50 consecutive turns without a capture or flip, the game is drawn. One player's action counts as one turn.
en.tutorial.actionDone: You did it! Look at how the board changed, then continue.
en.tutorial.tryAgain: This step is not complete yet. Check the hint and try again.
en.tutorial.finish: Practice complete! Try again or start a game.
